date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the page gives no earlier day for the forum post.
title: Claim: hacker says Decathlon customer data of 137 000 email addresses posted on a forum; not confirmed
summary: A hacker calling themselves "4me1" claims to have stolen Decathlon customer data and posted it on a forum, according to MCE TV, which relays Capital.fr. The article's headline puts the exposed email addresses at 137 000, a figure it attributes to Capital.fr. Money.pl, citing WNP, says the files appeared on the PwnForums hacker forum. MCE TV and Money.pl say Decathlon has not officially confirmed the attack.
plain: A hacker claims to have posted Decathlon customer data, including 137 000 email addresses, on a forum. Decathlon has not officially confirmed it, according to MCE TV.
exec: An unconfirmed claim of Decathlon customer data exposure, 137 000 email addresses per the headline; Decathlon has not confirmed.
action: MCE TV advises being wary of unexpected messages about an order or parcel, not clicking links in suspicious SMS or emails, and checking on the official Decathlon site or app.

evidence.quote: Decathlon visé par une fuite de données : 137 000 e-mails exposés
Decathlon nie przedstawił dotąd oficjalnego stanowiska w sprawie włamania

validation.note: MCE TV (relaying Capital.fr) and Money.pl (citing WNP) report the forum posting; both rely on relayed reporting and Decathlon has not confirmed, so it stays an unconfirmed claim.

review.note: compared claim status, 4me1, 137 000 (Capital.fr), non-confirmation and advice against MCE TV and Money.pl
